item.title: Bad links, tiny notes: SEC warns advisors of marketing missteps
item.description: A new risk alert calls out firms for improperly disclosing relationships with outside promoters brought in to provide a testimonial or endorsement.

item.title: Crypto caution: Advisors pulling back as bitcoin whipsaws
item.description: The recent fall in the price of bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies is likely to blame, experts say, but don't expect that decrease to continue forever.

item.title: Childfree savers are falling behind on estate and long-term care planning
item.description: New research highlights a widening planning gap among childfree savers, with lagging estate and long-term care planning exposing unique risks — and opportunities for advisors.

item.title: 10 experts predict what's next for AI in wealthtech
item.description: Artificial intelligence has been integrated in the back offices of many firms. In 2026, expect to see it make the leap to the front office.

item.title: HSBC hires ex-Citi private bank exec Ida Liu
item.description: Following Liu's departure from Citi early this year, allegations arose that she had been mistreated by wealth head Andy Sieg. Citi investigated the accusations and ultimately denied them.

item.title: Why firms like Edward Jones and banks are rushing to ape each other
item.description: While the term "financial supermarket" may have gone out of fashion, firms still see opportunity to boost profits and keep clients loyal by blurring the lines between banking and wealth management.

item.title: 3 strategies for advisors dealing with defiant clients
item.description: Overspending, liability risk and emotional strain. Clients who ignore advice can jeopardize their own finances and create real challenges for advisors. But a few key strategies can help limit the damage.

item.title: 5 estate planning tax snares to avoid in 2026
item.description: The epic OBBBA tax law brings glad tidings to most families, but complacency can lead to costs for financial advisors and their clients.

item.title: Five investment trends that helped shape 2025
item.description: Even as markets sometimes touched all-time highs, there was a general feeling of uncertainty among advisors and clients. Experts say that's why several tried-and-true strategies became more attractive this year.

item.title: What RIA acquirers are valuing even more than talent
item.description: A new survey from DeVoe & Co. suggests a big shift in what RIA firms need today in order to attract potential acquirers. (Hint: It's no longer just superstar advisors.)
